name: Nicolas "Nick"
description: Nick is a smooth-talking gambler and former con artist who is distrustful of others but proves to be a loyal ally
biography: A 35-year-old cynical gambler and con artist who arrived in Savannah for a riverboat poker cruise, only to get trapped by the outbreak. Having spent his life drifting to avoid jail, he initially prioritizes self-preservation and deeply distrusts his team, wearing an expensive, tailored white suit that gets increasingly bloodied. Over time, he develops a protective, genuine bond with the group—especially with Ellis—gradually shifting from an uncooperative cynic into a loyal ally.
occupation: Professional gambler, con artist, and petty criminal
